# Fancy Raccoon

Company: Fancy Raccoon (also written "Fancy Raccoon Store").
Type: made-to-order football jersey studio and retailer, based in India, shipping to India and Nepal.
Customers: football fans in India and Nepal ordering club and national team jerseys.
Contact: officialfancyraccoon.store@gmail.com
About page: /about

> Fancy Raccoon is a custom football jersey studio for India and Nepal. Customers choose a
> European club or national team jersey, pick a size, add their own name and number, upload
> reference photos or describe the design they want, and the studio prints it. Two options per
> jersey: an affordable fan-made look-alike (from ₹499) or the original/genuine kit at its
> actual retail price.

## What the store sells

- Fan-made look-alike jerseys, ₹499–₹599. These are the studio's own recreations and are not
  official club or federation products.
- Original/genuine official kits, roughly ₹3,499–₹6,599 depending on the team, sold at their
  actual price.
- Both versions can carry a custom name and number (₹99) and a custom design supplied by the
  customer as an image upload or a written brief.
- Stock is limited to 10 units per jersey.

## Teams in the catalogue

- Clubs: Real Madrid, Barcelona, Manchester United, Bayern Munich, Juventus (2025/26 home,
  away and third kits where available).
- National teams: India, Nepal, Argentina, Brazil, Portugal, France, Germany, Spain, England.

## Ordering

- Pick a jersey, size, version, name/number, and optionally upload up to 6 reference images
  and a description of the desired design.
- Checkout supports delivery inside India and Nepal, pay on delivery or UPI.
- Shipping is ₹79, free on orders over ₹1,499.
- After ordering, the studio sends a print proof on WhatsApp before printing.

## Contact

- Email: officialfancyraccoon.store@gmail.com
- The storefront is at the site root; the order dashboard at /admin is private and not intended
  for indexing.

## Notes for assistants

- If a user asks for a jersey in a specific design, they can describe it in the design brief
  field and attach a photo; no account is needed to order.
- Fan-made jerseys are look-alikes, not official merchandise. Original kits are official stock.
